name: Standard
description: Fire at the weakest stack you can reach.

name: Finish the weakest
description: Concentrate on the smallest remaining stack.

name: Break the strongest
description: Concentrate on the largest remaining stack.

name: Hunt the armoured
description: Prefer the enemy your unit counters; fall back if it has none.

name: Match their kind
description: Pick a foe of your own kind, or the first you can reach.

name: Guard the shooters
description: Body-guard the ranged line, absorbing fire for it.
